description: This file defines the 'operator' package implementing client interfaces and polled client management, including connection handling, messaging, and resource cleanup, for device communication.

classes.name: PolledClient
classes.description: Represents a polled device client with messaging and disconnection handling capabilities.

classes.name: PolledSet
classes.description: Manages a set of polled device clients, providing thread-safe connection creation and deletion.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a message to the client, appending it to the internal message list.

methods.name: OnDeviceDisconnected
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the device disconnects, removing the client from the set.

methods.name: ToDevice
methods.description: Sends a message directly to the associated device.

methods.name: GetMessages
methods.description: Retrieves a specified number of messages from the client's message queue, skipping initial messages.

methods.name: ClientId
methods.description: Returns the integer client ID assigned during registration.

methods.name: NewConnection
methods.description: Creates a new polled connection for a device, ensuring a unique connection ID.

methods.name: GetConnection
methods.description: Retrieves a connection by its ID.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Removes a connection from the set by its ID.
